title: Pergola Construction quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Construct and install a new freestanding timber pergola, approximately five metres long by three metres wide, attached to an existing paved patio area. This includes four treated pine posts, one hundred by one hundred millimetres, two point seven metres long, set into concrete footings with galvanised post stirrups. Two main beams, one hundred and forty by forty-five millimetres, five metres long, and two cross beams, one hundred and forty by forty-five millimetres, three metres long. Seven roof rafters, ninety by forty-five millimetres, three metres long. Roofing will be fifteen square metres of clear corrugated polycarbonate sheeting, fixed with appropriate flashing and fixings. All visible timber will be sanded and ready for painting by the homeowner. Includes disposal of all construction waste.
workingDetail: Posts (timber or steel), Beams and rafters, Roofing (polycarbonate, Colorbond, or shade cloth), Post brackets and stirrups
